# CLI reference

Every command's `--help`. The global `--config` option applies to all of them.

## nightshift

```text
Usage: nightshift [options] [command]

Spend idle coding-subscription quota overnight

Options:
  -c, --config <path>  config file (default: $NIGHT_SHIFT_CONFIG or
                       ~/.config/night-shift/config.yml)
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  init                 detect installed agents, pick providers, sources and a
                       starting queue
  config               inspect and validate the config
  plan                 show tonight's units in order, with each provider's
                       ceiling; runs no worker
  queue                show what each rule matches tonight and reorder the rules
                       with the keyboard
  skills               list skills and eject built-ins to tweak
  run [options]        plan tonight, run a worker per unit and publish draft PRs
                       and reports
  report [id]          print a run's morning report; the latest by default
  schedule             run night-shift every night on this machine
  ci                   run night-shift in GitHub Actions
  doctor               check binaries, credentials, quota and sources before a
                       night
  help [command]       display help for command
```

## nightshift config

```text
Usage: nightshift config [options] [command]

inspect and validate the config

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  schema          print the config JSON Schema, for editor autocompletion
  check           validate the config file
  edit            open the config in $VISUAL or $EDITOR; it is saved only once
                  valid
  help [command]  display help for command
```

## nightshift skills

```text
Usage: nightshift skills [options] [command]

list skills and eject built-ins to tweak

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  list            skills a rule can name, where each comes from and its delivery
                  default
  eject <name>    copy a built-in skill to ~/.config/night-shift/skills,
                  where it shadows the built-in
  help [command]  display help for command
```

## nightshift run

```text
Usage: nightshift run [options]

plan tonight, run a worker per unit and publish draft PRs and reports

Options:
  --dry-run    prepare each workspace (clone, context, prompt) but run no worker
  --unit <id>  run only this unit
  --scheduled  run only inside the night window and start no unit after it ends
  -h, --help   display help for command
```

## nightshift report

```text
Usage: nightshift report [options] [id]

print a run's morning report; the latest by default

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## nightshift schedule

```text
Usage: nightshift schedule [options] [command]

run night-shift every night on this machine

Options:
  -h, --help         display help for command

Commands:
  install [options]  start `nightshift run` at night.start; it starts no unit
                     after night.end
  remove             remove the nightly job
  help [command]     display help for command
```

## nightshift schedule install

```text
Usage: nightshift schedule install [options]

start `nightshift run` at night.start; it starts no unit after night.end

Options:
  --with <scheduler>  launchd, systemd, cron (default: launchd)
  -h, --help          display help for command
```

```text
Usage: nightshift schedule remove [options]

  -h, --help  display help for command
```
